Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of customer device. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Preferred language set on the device

Phone.name: Phone
Phone.definition: Phone number associated with the device.

IPAddress.name: IP Address
IPAddress.definition: Internet Protocol address associated with the device.

Email.name: Email
Email.definition: Electronic mail address associated with the device.

OperatingSystemType.name: Operating System Type
OperatingSystemType.definition: Type of device operating system. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

OperatingSystemBuild.name: Operating System Build
OperatingSystemBuild.definition: Build of the device operating system.

GeographicLocationSource.name: Geographic Location Source
GeographicLocationSource.definition: The source of geographic location source

DeviceTimeZone.name: Device Time Zone
DeviceTimeZone.definition: Contain the time zone of the device.

DeviceTimeZoneSource.name: Device Time Zone Source
DeviceTimeZoneSource.definition: Contains the source of device time zone.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
